steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-10, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104.3 | 6.31 | 6.31
2 | 416.7 | 17.57 | 23.88
3 | 264.5 | 2.29 | 26.17
4 | 856.9 | 2.63 | 28.80
5 | 641.5 | 26.88 | 55.68
6 | 7698.1 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as A-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-10, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station T-10, Survey Area T**

The VES interpretation at T-10 resolves six layers. Resistivity increases from 104.3 Ω·m (Layer 1) to a peak of 416.7 Ω·m (Layer 2), drops to 264.5 Ω·m (Layer 3), rises again to 856.9 Ω·m (Layer 4), dips to 641.5 Ω·m (Layer 5), then increases sharply to 7698.1 Ω·m (Layer 6, basement-like high-resistivity unit). This alternating pattern reflects interbedded higher- and lower-resistivity units down to ~56 m depth before the resistive base layer.

Applying standard curve-type notation to the five triplets of this six-layer model gives K-H-K-H, not a pure A-type (which requires monotonically increasing resistivity throughout). The on-file classification as "A-type" does not match the computed sequence and should be corrected or re-checked against the raw sounding data.
